print(spend(base + (upper,), "C1", decision_at=600))

title: A delivery retry preserves source availability
code:
from foundations_lab import Delivery, ingest, load_fixture, spend

ledger = load_fixture()
a1 = ledger.history[0]
retry = Delivery("a1-retry", a1, delivered_at=609)
replayed = ingest(ledger, [retry])
print(len(replayed.deliveries), len(replayed.history))
print(replayed.history[0].available_at)
print(spend(replayed.history, "C1", decision_at=600))

title: Reject the whole candidate batch
code:
from dataclasses import replace
from foundations_lab import ContractError, Delivery, ingest
from foundations_lab import Revision, load_fixture

ledger = load_fixture()
before = ledger
new = Delivery("n1", Revision("N", 1, "C1", 590, 591, 2), 591)
conflict = Delivery("a1-bad", replace(ledger.history[0], amount=21), 610)
try:
    ledger = ingest(ledger, [new, conflict])
except ContractError:
    print("ContractError")
print(ledger is before)

title: Replay order does not choose the revision
code:
from foundations_lab import Ledger, ingest, load_fixture, spend

original = load_fixture()
duplicated = ingest(original, original.deliveries)
print(duplicated == original)
replayed = ingest(Ledger(), reversed(original.deliveries))
print(replayed == original)
print(spend(replayed.history, "C1", decision_at=610))

title: A tombstone changes only eligible later queries
code:
from foundations_lab import load_fixture, spend, spend_in_window

history = load_fixture("deletion_extension").history
print(spend(history, "C1", decision_at=600))
print(spend(history, "C1", decision_at=610))
print(spend_in_window(history, "C1", window_start=540,
                      window_end=600, known_at=620))

title: Restoration requires an explicit ledger contract
code:
from foundations_lab import Delivery, Ledger, Revision, ingest
from foundations_lab import load_fixture, spend_in_window

ledger = Ledger(allow_restore=True)
ledger = ingest(ledger, load_fixture("deletion_extension").deliveries)
restore = Revision("C", 4, "C1", 585, 620, 28)
ledger = ingest(ledger, [Delivery("c4", restore, 620)])
print(spend_in_window(ledger.history, "C1", window_start=540,
                      window_end=600, known_at=620))
